# UP Apparel

> Veteran-founded UK clothing brand: military-inspired streetwear, gym wear and everyday clothing. Founded by British Army veteran James after 24 years' service. Motto: Utrinque Paratus ("ready for anything").

## Shop
- [Special editions](https://upapparel.co.uk/collections/special-editions/): Limited-run UP Apparel designs honouring Arnhem, St Michael, St Christopher and Remembrance. Heavyweight cotton, made in small numbers.
- [Hoodies](https://upapparel.co.uk/collections/hoodies/): Heavyweight military-inspired hoodies from UP Apparel, a veteran-founded UK brand. Special editions and everyday essentials, sizes S to 3XL.
- [T-shirts](https://upapparel.co.uk/collections/t-shirts/): Heavyweight garment-dyed and lightweight T-shirts from UP Apparel. Fitted for training, styled for the street. Sizes S to 4XL.
- [Headwear](https://upapparel.co.uk/collections/headwear/): UP Apparel caps and bucket hats: camo snapbacks, trucker caps and an old-school bucket hat. Built for the field, worn on the streets.
- [The Armoury](https://upapparel.co.uk/collections/the-armoury/): The UP Apparel Armoury: tactical patches, the UP Union Jack flag, mugs, stickers and gift cards. The finishing touches for your kit.
